concept.hr: Traženje susjeda ide na multicast adresu traženog čvora, ne svima
concept.en: Neighbour solicitation goes to the solicited-node multicast, not to all

summary.hr: Isti traženi susjed dvaput: ARP zahtjev moraju pogledati svi, NS samo računalo u grupi traženog čvora. Kad nitko ne odgovori i kad oglas stigne izvana.
summary.en: One neighbour looked up twice: every CPU looks at the ARP request, only the solicited-node group's at the NS. With no answer, and a forged advertisement.

concept.hr: Tri NS-a u razmaku od 1 s, zatim „address unreachable”
concept.en: Three NSs 1 s apart, then "address unreachable"

concept.hr: Oglas susjeda koji je prošao usmjernik odbacuje se
concept.en: A neighbour advertisement that crossed a router is dropped
